raw.query: SELECT r.window_name, r.ratio_vs_static, w.ratio_a2_lead30_vs_static, r.feasible FROM provenance.v_ewma_ablation_ratio r LEFT JOIN provenance.v_window_cost_ratio w ON r.window_name = w.window_name WHERE r.model = 'chronos' AND r.quantile = 'p90' AND r.rho = 15 AND r.readiness = 'warm' AND r.lead_s = 30 ORDER BY r.window_name;
raw.observed: aggregate: 0.6231 (feasible: true); burst1: 3.0072; burst3: 2.8425; burst4: 3.0006; burst5: 1.1425
raw.claimed: 0.62 times static worker-time in aggregate; per burst window every arm costs more than static
raw.evidence: v_ewma_ablation_ratio shows the Chronos p90 rho=15 warm readiness L=30 policy is feasible (feasible=true) at 0.6231x static, and v_window_cost_ratio confirms it costs > 1.0x static in all burst windows (1.14x - 3.01x).
